titulo: Conjugate valer in the simple future
subtitulo: Valer slips in a d: valdré, valdrás, valdremos. Worth, cost, good enough.
regla: Valer replaces the e of its infinitive with d to make the stem valdr-, then adds -é, -ás, -á, -emos, -án.

bloques.texto: **Valer** (_to be worth, to cost_) is irregular in the **simple future** (**futuro imperfecto**). The endings are regular; the stem is **valdr-**: the **e** becomes a **d**.

**Valer** has several meanings. With things it means _to cost_ or _to be worth_. With people: **valer para** + something = _to be good enough for, to be cut out for_; **valer como** + something = _to be useful as, to do as_. In Mexico, for people you'll more often hear **servir para**: **no servirás para eso**.

filas: La tabla valdrá unos tres mil pesos.
No valdrás para el torneo si no entrenas.
to be useful as, to do as

bloques.texto: Tip: **valer** is in the **d** gang with **poner**, **tener**, **venir** and **salir**: **valdré**, **pondré**, **tendré**, **vendré**, **saldré**.

lista.es: ==Valdré== más en el trabajo si aprendo a programar llaves.
lista.en: I'll be worth more at work if I learn to program keys.

lista.es: No ==valdrás== para competir si no entrenas.
lista.en: You won't be good enough to compete if you don't train.

lista.es: En unos meses ese Tsuru ==valdrá== la mitad.
lista.en: In a few months that Tsuru will be worth half as much.

lista.es: ==Valdrá== la pena levantarse temprano: habrá olas.
lista.en: It'll be worth getting up early: there'll be waves.

lista.es: Esas tablas usadas ==valdrán== unos dos mil pesos.
lista.en: Those used boards will cost about two thousand pesos.

lista.es: Tu historia ==valdrá== como ejemplo para los nuevos.
lista.en: Your story will serve as an example for the new guys.

lista.nota: The things that cost are the subject: plural things, plural verb.

lista.texto: The endings are the same as for every verb in the future: [[5155|regular verbs in the simple future]].
The conditional uses the very same stem, with **-ía** endings: [[5818|valer in the conditional]].
The future also guesses about right now (_I wonder how much it costs_): [[5060|the future for probability]].
The future of **haber** + participle: [[5066|irregular verbs in the future perfect]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.r: Esos aguacates valdrán más en invierno.

lista.p: In Spanish: _You (tú) won't be good enough to be a doctor if you don't study._
lista.r: No valdrás para ser doctor si no estudias.

lista.p: Which one? **La casa valerá el doble** or **La casa valdrá el doble**.
